summary: Lincoln County, MT lookout about 15 miles southwest of Eureka. Its tower dates to the 1930s and is listed as gone; no source describes what remains.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone. No source describes what, if anything, remains at the site.

evidence.supports: FFLA lists status gone with coordinates 48.75705 -115.32430

notes_for_editor: Thin record: a single detailed site listing (firelookout.com) gives the 1930s date (no year, so no dated event is recorded), the 4,530-foot elevation and the gone status. The FFLA and Forest Lookouts lists add coordinates and a land description only. No builder, design, staffing, fire, access or photo information was found. The land description (35N-29W-25) was not checked against the coordinates.
